entities.name: Muzzio
entities.description: Visionary human artificer at the High City of Paliano on Fiora, who became vice-chancellor of the Academy.

entities.name: Black Rose
entities.description: Group Muzzio is rumored to serve.

entities.name: Sydri
entities.description: Dropout rumored to still have Muzzio as patron.

entities.name: Brago
entities.description: Ruler of Paliano whose ghostly reign led to Muzzio's exile.

entities.name: Grenzo
entities.description: Goblin prison warden tipped off by Daretti.

events.summary: Muzzio blackmails and removes three senior advisors and becomes vice-chancellor after all.
Daretti tips off Grenzo about Muzzio's storehouse of cogwork warriors.
Brago outlaws cogwork constructs, closes the Academy and exiles Muzzio.
events.quote: Brago outlawed cogwork constructs, closed the Academy, and exiled Muzzio

relations.note: Former pupil, suspected of killing him.
